title: Three leaders, three agendas: Who wants what from Xi-Trump-Putin summit?
summary: Be it curbing arms sales to Taiwan, bouncing back after a midterms shellacking, or the optics of a place at the table with the world's two superpowers, Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin are approaching their trilateral meeting in Shenzhen with starkly different aims and agendas. Here's a look at what the Chinese, US and Russian leaders are hoping…
